summary: Completed comprehensive testing of News Module (Noticias Institucionales). Backend: 35/35 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features verified - News CRUD, filters (Todas/Borrador/Publicado/Archivado), pinned news with badge, context menu actions, view modal, create/edit modal with 3 tabs.
passed_tests: GET /api/news - Returns list of news articles with pagination
POST /api/news - Creates news with cover image
POST /api/news - Creates news with visibility settings
GET /api/news/{id} - Returns single news with enriched data
PUT /api/news/{id}/publish - Returns error for already published
PUT /api/news/{id}/archive - Returns error for already archived
Integration: Full workflow Draft -> Published -> Pinned -> Archived
Integration: Maximum 3 pinned news limit enforced
Integration: News includes enriched data (author_name, status_label, status_color)
Frontend: Sidebar has 'Noticias' navigation item with Newspaper icon
Frontend: Filter buttons work (Todas, Borrador, Publicado, Archivado)
Frontend: 'Nueva noticia' button opens create modal
Frontend: Create modal has 3 tabs (Contenido, Multimedia, Visibilidad)
Frontend: Create modal has required fields (Título, Resumen, Contenido)
Frontend: News cards show author avatar, name, date, title, summary
Frontend: 'Leer más' button opens view modal
Frontend: View modal shows full content with author info
Frontend: Context menu (⋯) shows actions for admins
Frontend: Context menu has Ver noticia, Editar, Quitar destacado, Archivar, Eliminar
seed_data_creation: Existing pinned news 'Bienvenidos al nuevo año escolar 2026' used for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: News module fully functional. Route is /school/:subdomain/noticias. Admin roles (owner/admin/director) can create/edit/delete news and change status. Statuses: draft/published/archived. Pinned news (max 3) appear first with 'Destacado' badge. Create modal has 3 tabs: Contenido (title, summary, content), Multimedia (cover image, gallery), Visibilidad (roles, grades, sections). View modal shows full content. Context menu has all actions. Cloudinary integration for images.

backend_endpoints.GET /api/news: List news with filters (status, pinned_only, page, limit)
backend_endpoints.GET /api/news/{id}: Get single news with enriched data (author_name, author_photo, status_label, status_color)
backend_endpoints.POST /api/news: Create news with title, content, summary, cover_image, gallery, visibility, status, pinned

frontend_components.NewsPage: Main page with header, filters, news grid
frontend_components.NewsCard: Card with author avatar, date, title, summary, 'Leer más', context menu
frontend_components.NewsFormModal: Create/edit modal with 3 tabs (Contenido, Multimedia, Visibilidad)
frontend_components.ViewNewsModal: Full content view with author info, title, content, gallery
